closed_findings: The independent CP2 reconstruction reproduced the retained 2025 Return and combined stressed deltas within 0.03 and 0.02 dollars respectively.

The effect did not generalize materially: RETURN_CONTRACTION improved pooled stressed net by 5.6383 dollars and RECEIVER_TIME_FIELD by 9.7681 dollars, both below the frozen 20.352385-dollar requirement.
RECEIVER_TIME_FIELD also worsened summed stressed closed drawdown by 0.1007 dollars.
Both candidates lost the same 2022-10-07 17:00 US100 Cross entry after candidate path economics kept Return risk occupied until 17:01:24; this produced one additional risk-admission skip.
Qualification density was sufficient. The failure is temporal concentration and portfolio path interaction, not sparse samples or reconstruction error.
